summary: This bill requires the Secretary of State to submit an annual report to Congress detailing adverse security clearance decisions, appeals, and success rates, disaggregated by position, ethnicity, national origin, race, and gender.

scores.thoughts: This bill requires the Secretary of State to submit annual reports on security clearance adjudications. While report generation incurs some administrative costs, these are minimal and incidental to the bill's primary purpose of transparency, not a central focus on government spending levels.
